description: Renders a single Notion page: header (via TmNotionPageHeader), block list and comments area. Loads blocks via and manages block state.

parameters.name: AvailableReactions
parameters.description: Available emoji reactions shown by the picker.

parameters.name: Blocks
parameters.description: Currently loaded page blocks. When absent, the component loads them from the block provider.

parameters.name: EffectivePermission
parameters.description: Effective permission for the current user on this page.

parameters.name: OnAIAskPageRequested
parameters.description: Raised when user picks the AI page summary action.

parameters.name: OnAISummarizeRequested
parameters.description: Raised when user picks "Page restrictions".

parameters.name: OnCommentBadgeClicked
parameters.description: Total unresolved comment count for the page (header badge).

parameters.name: OnCreateTokenRequested
parameters.type: Func<string, Task<(string Key, string DisplayName, string? ColorClass)?>?>?
parameters.description: Called when the user clicks "Create token" in the token dropdown. Arg = current search query (may be empty). Return the newly created token (Key, DisplayName, ColorClass) so the editor can insert it automatically, or null if the user cancelled.

parameters.name: OnNavigateToImportedPage
parameters.description: Raised when user picks the AI page question action.

parameters.name: OnNavigateToPage
parameters.description: Raised when the user clicks a child-page link or mention.

parameters.name: OnPageDeleted
parameters.description: Raised when page metadata (IsFullWidth, IsSmallText, IsLocked, IsFavorite) changes.

parameters.name: OnPageHistoryRequested
parameters.description: Raised after page is moved to trash — parent should navigate away.

parameters.name: OnPageInfoRequested
parameters.description: Raised when user picks "Page history".

parameters.name: OnPageUpdated
parameters.description: Raised after the page metadata (title, icon, cover) is saved.

parameters.name: OnPermissionsChanged
parameters.description: Raised after page restrictions are saved.

parameters.name: OnRestrictionsRequested
parameters.description: Raised when user picks "Share".

parameters.name: OnShareRequested
parameters.description: Raised when user picks "Page info".

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The page to display (required).

parameters.name: PageId
parameters.description: Page identifier for reaction aggregation.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: When true all editing interactions are disabled.

parameters.name: UnresolvedCommentCount
parameters.description: Fired when Enter is pressed in the title, signalling to add a new block.

parameters.name: Visible
parameters.description: Shows the panel when true.

parameters.name: VisibleChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the visibility changes.
